title: Isomer plan
description: Declarative reorganization plan: the desired end state of a base..head commit range. Authored by an agent, validated by `ism check`, executed atomically by `ism apply`.

snapshot_digest.description: The snapshot_digest from `ism inspect` this plan was computed against. Apply refuses stale plans (E010).

base.description: Optional re-anchoring: base sha the plan assumes.

head.description: Optional re-anchoring: head sha the plan assumes.

name.description: Human-readable node name, unique within the plan.

change.description: Existing change id to preserve; omitted → a fresh id is minted.

summary.description: One-line intent; becomes the commit title.

body.description: Longer description; becomes the commit body.

from.description: Content source: an explicit hunk id list, or "commit:<sha>" for every hunk of one commit (pick sugar).

deps.description: Soft (semantic) dependencies: names or change ids of earlier nodes. Not verified for replayability — hard dependencies are computed by ism itself.

order.description: Node sequence (names or change ids). Must be a linearization of the hard-dependency DAG (E030 otherwise).
